metriq.name: metriq-data
metriq.selection: All JSON record arrays under metriq-gym/v*/; identical complete records deduplicated with all source locations retained. No metric aggregation or ranking.

summary.scope: Independent scientific scope and numerical forward-testing of four L1 capabilities. Direct fixed-environment workers and actual JS normalizers; no Harness or external-model acceptance.
summary.independence: Requests, analytical references and checks selected by reviewer; product live tests and their conclusions were not read.

cases.dynamiqs-dynamics: Rabi oscillations; undriven excited-state exponential decay; affine Bloch-generator expm and expm_frechet for generic plus state and allowed extreme parameters.
cases.clifft-sampling: Asymmetric CX bit order; H-T-S-H interference; CZ Bell correlation; classical Pauli-channel error enumeration; six-qubit 64-gate 8192-shot product-channel boundary.
cases.oqupy-dynamics: Zero/finite-temperature exact pure dephasing; zero-bath Bloch rotation; 0.1 duration / 11-step floating-point grid failure and fixed rerun.
cases.deltakit-qec: 3x5 X and 5x3 Z memory, three rounds, zero and 0.02 ToyNoise, seeded resampling, single-fault corrections, graphlike distance, Wilson roots, and cross-process byte reproducibility.

findings.impact: Valid input failed because upstream int(end_time/dt) floored 10.999999999999998 to 10.

findings.reproduction: 5x3 Z, rounds=3, p=0.02, shots=4096, seed=718; workers PYTHONHASHSEED=0 vs 8192
findings.impact: OBSERVABLE_INCLUDE record-target permutation changes circuit bytes and SHA but not parity or observed failures.
findings.fix: Sort only pure measurement-record operands within DETECTOR/OBSERVABLE_INCLUDE, preserving multiplicity and measurement/gate schedule.
findings.closure: Six process invocations with Python hash seeds 0, 1, 8192, 2147483647, random and random produced identical full results, circuits and resampled detector/observable bytes; 128 exhaustive measurement-record combinations preserve parity, including duplicates and repeat blocks.

limits: Finite independent examples, not exhaustive parameter-space validation.
Finite-memory interacting TEMPO convergence and observable error bounds not certified.
MWPM model reviewed and single faults checked; no threshold or calibrated hardware claim.
Clifft multinomial deviations checked against sample size; no large-scale performance result.

Initial direct-worker test envelopes use a synthetic review source label, so their wrappers are not Harness provenance; installed package versions were separately inspected and corrected-source wrappers were used for fixed reruns.
summary.reviewConclusion: No remaining actionable scientific-scope or numerical issue found in the reviewed examples. This closes the independent review findings, not central scientific acceptance.
